decisions.reason: A candle arch line close to the core craft offer, featured on the home page, costs little to keep in the catalogue while seasonal demand is still uncertain.
A one-tier pyramid fits the established offer and is shown prominently, so keeping this cheap option open is worth more than its carrying cost.
Although distant from the core, the music box line is presented as a flagship, and only one year of evidence leaves high uncertainty, so the option should be kept.
This accessory platform is only mentioned rather than featured, but it supports the flagship music box and costs little to keep, so it stays while the line's value resolves.
A seasonal accessory with low visibility and some overlap with D carries modest drop risk, but its tie to the music box line justifies keeping it for now.
A themed pyramid that builds on core competencies and is shown on the home page is a low-cost option with continuing collector appeal.
